response.why: Attacking with everything guarantees Preacher's attack trigger (draw a card, lose 1 life) regardless of blocks, and even in the worst case where Enduring Curiosity blocks and kills Preacher, my life/opponent-life totals match the safe 'hold Preacher' line exactly — but I additionally get a free card and permanently strip Enduring Curiosity's creature status (it can never attack or block again). That's a good trade even losing Preacher; not attacking with everyone leaves value on the table.
response.plan: Attack with both Bats and Preacher — Bats are unblockable (their only untapped blocker has no flying), and Preacher's attack trigger nets me a card either way; if they block Preacher with Enduring Curiosity I trade it away but permanently de-fang their best creature.
